request.prompt:
Game sprite parts sheet for "Rina", a chibi gunner girl: her ARMS and GLOVES only, as separate cut-out pieces for a 2D skeletal (cut-out) animation. Match the reference images exactly: same art style (thick dark brown outlines, soft cel shading), same colors and the same scale as the body parts in Reference 2. Reference 1 shows her front, right-side and back views (note her short puffy ivory sleeves and big round brown mitten gloves). Reference 2 is the approved parts sheet (head+torso, ponytail, scarf tail).

Draw these pieces, each fully isolated with a wide empty white gap around it (no overlaps, no touching), arranged in a neat grid:

ROW 1 - SLEEVES (ivory cloth, same color as her tunic):
- PIECE S1: upper-arm sleeve segment, a short puffy ivory sleeve tube, drawn horizontally, both ends ROUNDED like a capsule so it can rotate at the joints without gaps.
- PIECE S2: forearm segment, a shorter ivory sleeve tube drawn horizontally, the left end rounded (elbow) and the right end with a slightly wider cuff opening where the glove attaches.

ROW 2 - GLOVES GRIPPING (big round brown mitten gloves like Reference 1, clenched as if holding a pistol grip, but NO gun):
- PIECE G1: gripping fist seen from the side (thumb on top), knuckles pointing right.
- PIECE G2: gripping fist seen from the front (knuckles facing the viewer).
- PIECE G3: gripping fist seen from behind (back of the hand).
- PIECE G4: gripping fist seen at three-quarter angle.

ROW 3 - OTHER HAND POSES (same brown mittens):
- PIECE H1: open mitten palm up, as a supporting hand under a gun barrel, seen from the side.
- PIECE H2: open mitten reaching forward, fingers together, flat, seen from the side (for a diving pose).
- PIECE H3: open mitten reaching forward seen from the front.

Each glove has a short ivory-sleeve-free wrist opening on its left side where it attaches to the forearm cuff. All gloves the same size (about the size of her gloves in Reference 1 relative to her head). No arms attached to gloves, no gun, no body, no text, no labels, no arrows, no frames, no shadows, no ground. Flat pure white background.
